_comment: Step zero only — see docs/step-zero-websocket.md. A SUBSET of vars-q2.json: the five values the stub needs, and nothing procurement-gated. Deliberately a separate file rather than reusing vars-q2.json, because that one still carries REPLACE_ME_gcp_project_id and REPLACE_ME_vertex_region at this point in the schedule, and there is no reason step zero should wait on a GCP project it does not dial. Fill these five from the SAME source as vars-q2.json — app_name, namespace, team, tenant, group and the two ingresses must be IDENTICAL in both files, or the stub proves the upgrade for a different app than the one that gets deployed.
_comment_echo_image: The full pushed reference of the echo image, built from build/echo/. e.g. europe-north1-docker.pkg.dev/nais-management-233d/<team>/melosys-muninn-echo:<tag>. It must live in an allowed registry — the team GAR, or a third-party image mirrored there.
